definitions.explanation: A specific calendar date expressed as year, month, and day. Commonly used on official documents and forms where a full date must be written.

examples.japanese: {年月日|ねんがっぴ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{生年月日|せいねんがっぴ}→生年月日：03293_seinengappi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1990⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧5⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧10⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧です。
examples.english: My date of birth is May 10, 1990.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{年月日|ねんがっぴ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{署名|しょめい}→署名：03682_shomei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't forget to write the date and your signature on the contract.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (year), ⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧ (month), and ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (day). Very common on Japanese forms and official documents. In Japanese date format, the order is always year → month → day.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年月日|ねんがっぴ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fill in the date
- ⟦{生年月日|せいねんがっぴ}→生年月日：03293_seinengappi⟧: date of birth
- ⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧{年月日|ねんがっぴ}: date of issue
- {届出|とどけで}{年月日|ねんがっぴ}: date of notification

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese official documents traditionally use the Japanese era system (⟦{和暦|われき}→和暦：28485_wareki⟧) for dates (e.g., ⟦{令和|れいわ}→令和：11181_reiwa⟧8⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧), though Western calendar dates (⟦{西暦|せいれき}→西暦：04355_seireki⟧) are also widely accepted. The ⟦{生年月日|せいねんがっぴ}→生年月日：03293_seinengappi⟧ field appears on nearly every official form in Japan.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{日付|ひづけ}→日付：03706_hizuke⟧: date — more general and conversational
- ⟦{日時|にちじ}→日時：00316_nichiji⟧: date and time
